title: Patch: the AI without its learned evaluation is generation 14, so the shadow ban is swept on it and the ladder bots' ratings re-settle
thread:
**Issue #4921 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4921: Patch: the AI without its learned evaluation is generation 14, so the shadow ban is swept on it and the ladder bots' ratings re-settle
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Since 19 November the practice AI plays without the learned network it used to score its lines, and that changed many of its decisions. The repository still says the AI is generation 13, the generation that network made. Three things are meant to follow a new AI, and all three read that number. The first is the automatic re-check of the cards the AI may keep out of its own decks. The second is the ladder bots' ratings: each bot is meant to become less certain once, so its rating can move to the new AI's strength. The third is the label on every recorded game. None of them noticed the change.

Once this is built, the AI is generation 14, with a history line saying why. The card re-check runs on main by itself. Each ladder bot's next rated game widens its rating's uncertainty once. New game records name the AI that actually played them.

## Why

- `crates/ai/generation.json` names generation 13, lane `learn`, dated 2026-10-21. That was the learn lane's one promotion, the learned evaluation. `training/README.md` (Reading the history) says this file is the AI on `main`.
- R4159000 retired that evaluation on 2026-11-19 (`d40d3a457d`). Its note says: 'With the correction gone, the AI's decisions move wherever it applied'. Three pinned decisions moved, and the dungeon's elite tiers were retuned (`RUN_ELITE_TIERS`). The generation did not move, and the note calls the sweep of record 'unchanged'.
- The sweep of record (R1678000) starts only on a push to `main` that moves `generation.json`'s `generation` or ships a set (`.github/workflows/sweep.yml`, `on.push.paths`; `crates/tools/src/sweep.rs:1169`, `ai_changed = … base_generation != generation`).
  - The last reports of record, `training/history/sweep-2026-11-13*.md`, ran on generation 13 with the network on.
  - When the generation moves, `due_ids` (`sweep.rs:1112`) names every `SHADOW_WATCH` card of a set that may hold bans. By my count of `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs` that is 189 rows: 10 Meditative, 9 Meditative+, 85 Stinkyscape, 67 Stinkyscape+ and 18 Training Grounds. None of them has been measured on the AI that plays now.
- R1560000 widens a ladder bot's deviation once, when the server's generation is newer than the one the bot was last rated on (`crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs:238-269`, `BOT_PROMOTION_DEVIATION_BOOST` 150). With the number stuck at 13, bots rated on the network keep a settled deviation while playing another AI, so each game moves their rating only a little toward its strength. `docs/bot-calibration.md:152` puts the last calibration at generation 13, on 2026-10-28.
- Every record names the generation of the build that played it (`RecordBuild.ai_generation`, `crates/engine/src/wire/stats.rs:385`, read from `jackioh_ai::ai_generation`, `crates/ai/src/dev_run.rs:72`). Since 2026-11-19 the gather lane's records and the live records (`crates/server/src/api/game_records.rs:349`) say 13 for an AI that is not generation 13's.
- `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` is 13 (`crates/engine/src/config.rs:2418`). The fit it names (#4574, 2026-11-24) reads swing rows written by `evaluate`, the hand evaluation (`crates/ai/src/swing_turns.rs:150`, a file added that day). The retirement did not change that evaluation.
- A generation no lane made has a precedent: generation 9, #732's one-off, with lane `meditative` in `training/history/meditative.jsonl`.

## Proposal

1. `crates/ai/generation.json` becomes generation 14, lane `hand`:
   - `parent`: the last `main` commit before R4159000 merged (`d40d3a457d`'s first parent).
   - `tree`: the tree of `crates/ai/src` at the branch's base.
   - `vsRandom` and `vsParent`: `null`.
   - `shadowBan` and `parentShadowBan`: 0.
   - `date`: the build day.
   
   The same line goes in a new `training/history/hand.jsonl`.
2. `vsParent` stays `null`. A build of generation 13's commit would play today's cards by its own older definitions, from before every balance patch since. A screen against it would measure stale card text as much as the evaluation. `promotions_of` skips a line without a `vsParent` (`crates/server/src/cli/bot_calibrate.rs:150-153`), so the calibration anchor moves by nothing rather than by a guess.
3. `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` becomes 14 and its weights stay as they are. Its comment says the fit's rows came from the hand evaluation. `stats calibrate` then stops warning on generation-14 records (`crates/tools/src/win_probability.rs:294`).
4. `training/README.md` (Reading the history) gets a paragraph on generation 14 beside generation 9's. A ruling note records the decision and two rejected alternatives:
   - Bumping the generation on every AI fix: upkeep on every change, and each bump would start a sweep of several runner-hours.
   - Leaving it at 13: while no lane promotes, no AI change would start either trigger again.
5. Nothing else moves. No deck, decision or game hash reads the number.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/generation.json`
- `training/history/hand.jsonl` (new)
- `training/README.md`
- `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (`WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION`)
- a test in `crates/ai/tests/ai/dev_run.rs`
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md` and `spec/pending/<issue>.md`: §9.9, citing R1367000, R1560000, R1678000 and R4159000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `generation.json` names generation 14, lane `hand`, `vsParent` `null`, and a `shadowBan` equal to `SHADOW_BAN.len()`. `training/history/hand.jsonl` holds the same line.
- [ ] A test named after the ruling fails on today's tree. It checks that `jackioh_ai::ai_generation()` is 14 and that `generation.json`'s line is the last line of `hand.jsonl`.
- [ ] On the branch, `cargo jackioh sweep --due origin/main` reports base generation 13 and generation 14, and names the watched cards of the sets that may hold bans. The pull request gives the count.
- [ ] `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` is 14, its four weights are unchanged, and `cargo test -p jackioh-tools win_probability` passes.
- [ ] The AI's `shadow_ban` and `dev_run` tests pass, and so do the analysis package's `load_generations` tests and its notebook test (`analysis/tests`).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks

Small: about seven files and no Rust logic. The cost comes after the merge, on `main`:

- The sweep of record plays about 190 cards on both faces, across up to `SWEEP_SHARDS_MAX` (10) runner jobs. That is a few hours of runner time shared with CI.
- The sweep may ban cards within each set's ceiling, which is its job. Its own pull request records the practice-claim fixture again.
- The sweep's push needs `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` to still be valid (`docs/repository-secrets.md`). Without it, the run ends red and leaves its record as an artifact for a person.
- Each ladder bot widens once, capped at a new player's deviation, on its first rated game after the deploy. That happens only while `LADDER_BOTS` is on.
- Re-running `bot-calibrate` stays the follow-on `docs/bot-calibration.md` already prescribes. It is not part of this change.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Area: `ai` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `ai` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

**Judge:** leaves it to a person: The claims check out, but raising the generation launches a sweep of several runner-hours that can shadow-ban some of 189 cards and resets every ladder bot's rating certainty, with nothing measured to show today's bans or ratings are wrong; 35 commits have changed crates/ai/src since 2026-11-19 without a bump, so whether this one change deserves a new generation is the maintainers' call.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45683173196)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The AI without its learned evaluation becomes generation 14, lane `hand`. `crates/ai/generation.json` and a new `training/history/hand.jsonl` say so, with `vsRandom` and `vsParent` `null` and `shadowBan` 0 (equal to `SHADOW_BAN.len()`). A new ruling, R4921000, records why, and it rejects two alternatives.

- `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` becomes 14, with its four weights unchanged.
- A test named after the ruling fails on today's tree. It checks that `jackioh_ai::ai_generation()` is 14 and that `generation.json` matches the last line of `hand.jsonl`.
- `cargo jackioh sweep --due origin/main` on the branch reports base generation 13, generation 14 and the due count. The report gives that count.
- Nothing else moves: no decision, deck or game hash reads the number.

The maintainer approved this on 2026-11-25.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/generation.json` | change | Generation 14, lane `hand`, parent, tree, nulls, zeros, date (Step 5). Keep the layout. |
| `training/history/hand.jsonl` | new | The same record as one compact line, plus a trailing newline. |
| `crates/engine/src/config.rs` | change | `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` 13 to 14 (line 2418), and its doc comment. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/dev_run.rs` | change | Two `include_str!` consts and the test `r4921000_…`. |
| `scripts/ci-scope.sh` | change | One arm for `hand.jsonl` and one header sentence. |
| `spec/rulings/R4921000.md` | new | The ruling. |
| `spec/pending/4921.md` | new | The §11 paragraph. |
| `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md` | change | One sentence in the **Decks** bullet, after the R1678000 sentence. |
| `training/README.md` | change | "Reading the history": a generation 14 paragraph after generation 9's. |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | One sentence at the end of "When it is swept". |

**Must not touch:**
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` and `.claude/`.
- Anything under `crates/ai/src/`. It would change the `tree` value and `shadow_ban.rs`'s table.
- `crates/shared/src/config.rs`. `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` stays 13.
- `crates/server/`, `docs/bot-calibration.md`, the other `training/history/` files, and `apps/web/src/wire/`.

**Governing rulings:** R1367000, R1560000, R1678000, R4159000, R4552000, R732001; §9.9.

## Steps

1. **Get the values.**
   - `git rev-parse d40d3a457d^1` must print `7d2cf6960b0060bd642827baa5fb4a52de7a082a`. This is the last `main` commit that still had the learned evaluation.
   - `git rev-parse HEAD:crates/ai/src` should print `420e4a199be7f9b4e8373b98bef7d694b01378fd`. If it prints another value, use what it prints.
   - `date -u +%F` gives `<DATE>`. Use that one value in both files and in the ruling.
2. **Create `training/history/hand.jsonl` first**, one line, key order as in `learn.jsonl`: `{"generation":14,"lane":"hand","parent":"7d2cf6960b0060bd642827baa5fb4a52de7a082a","tree":"<tree>","vsRandom":null,"vsParent":null,"shadowBan":0,"parentShadowBan":0,"date":"<DATE>"}`. End the file with `\n`.
3. **Add the test to `crates/ai/tests/ai/dev_run.rs`.**
   - Under `QUICK`, add `const GENERATION_JSON: &str = include_str!("../../generation.json");` and `const HAND_HISTORY: &str = include_str!("../../../../training/history/hand.jsonl");`. Comment that a pure crate reads data at compile time only (rule 4).
   - Inside `mod the_ais_development_run_9_11`, right after `r1367000_…`, add `fn r4921000_the_ai_without_its_learned_evaluation_is_generation_14_and_hand_jsonl_holds_its_line()` (details under Tests).
4. **Run the test and watch it fail.** Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r4921000`. `generation.json` still says 13, so it fails with `left: Some(13), right: Some(14)`. Keep that line for the report.
5. **Rewrite `crates/ai/generation.json`.** Use exactly this layout:
   - one key per line, 2-space indent, trailing `\n`;
   - keys in this order: `generation` 14, `lane` `"hand"`, `parent`, `tree`, `vsRandom` null, `vsParent` null, `shadowBan` 0, `parentShadowBan` 0, `date`;
   - `  "shadowBan": 0,` on a line of its own, because `.github/workflows/sweep.yml:517` rewrites that line with `sed`.
6. **Re-run** `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r4921000`. It must pass.
7. **`crates/engine/src/config.rs`.** Set `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION: i32 = 14;` and leave the four weights alone. Append to its doc comment: "R4921000: 14. The fit's rows (`swingTurns`, #4574) were written from 2026-11-24, after R4159000 retired the learned evaluation, by `evaluate`, the hand evaluation, which that retirement left as it was; the generation only now names the AI that played them, so the weights stand."
8. **`scripts/ci-scope.sh`.**
   - Code: the arm `    training/history/hand.jsonl) on rust_ai ;;` goes right after the arm ending `training/history/sweep-*.md) on rust_tools_wasm ;;` (about line 368).
   - Header: in the "files outside a crate that its tests read" list (about lines 119–125), after the `training/history/sweep-*.md … tools, wasm;` item, add "training/history/hand.jsonl (the AI's test that holds generation.json to its history line, R4921000) ai;".
   - This arm is required. `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` (`ci_scope_runs_a_crates_groups_for_every_file_it_includes_from_outside_it`) fails without it, because the new test includes a file outside `crates/ai`.
9. **`spec/rulings/R4921000.md`.**
   - Front matter: `id: R4921000`; `title: "The AI without its learned evaluation is generation 14, recorded by hand in lane \`hand\` (issue #4921)"`; `cards: "§9.9, R732001, R1367000, R1560000, R1678000, R4159000, R4552000"`; `proven_in:` the one file `crates/ai/tests/ai/dev_run.rs`.
   - Body, every ruling and section written as `[[…]]` links, covering these points:
     - **What was wrong.** [[R4159000]] retired the learned evaluation on 2026-11-19 and moved decisions, but the number stayed 13. So [[R1678000]]'s sweep, [[R1560000]]'s bot re-settling and [[R1367000]]'s record builds did not move.
     - **What holds now.** Generation 14, lane `hand`, is written by hand when a change to the AI that no lane promoted moves its decisions. State `parent`, `tree`, `shadowBan` and `parentShadowBan`.
     - **`vsParent` stays null.** A build of generation 13's commit plays today's cards by older definitions. `promotions_of` skips such a line, so `bot-calibrate`'s anchor moves by nothing and `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` stays 13.
     - **Sweep and `shadowBan`.** The sweep that follows rewrites `generation.json`'s `shadowBan` alone, so the history line keeps its 0, as `learn.jsonl` keeps 17.
     - **Consequences.** The measured `sweep --due` count; each bot widening once ([[R1560000]]); records naming 14.
     - **WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION.** It is 14 with the same weights ([[R4552000]]).
     - **Rejected:** bumping on every AI fix (upkeep on every change, and each bump starts a sweep of several runner-hours); leaving it at 13 (while no lane promotes, no AI change would start the sweep or the re-settling again); screening against generation 13's build (stale card text).
   - Hearthstone has no counterpart; say so, as R1678000 does.
10. **`spec/pending/4921.md`**: one paragraph, in the style of `spec/pending/4863.md`. `**[[R4921000]] The AI without its learned evaluation is generation 14, recorded by hand (issue #4921, <DATE>)**: asked by #4921 after [[R4159000]] left the generation at 13 … Edits [[§9.9]]'s Decks bullet. Takes R4921000.` Do not restate the note.
11. **`spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`.** In the **Decks** bullet, after "… over that set's cards ([[R1678000]])." add: " A change to the AI that no lane promoted moves that generation by hand, as the retirement of the learned evaluation did (generation 14, lane `hand`, [[R4921000]])."
12. **`training/README.md`**, "Reading the history": after the generation 9 paragraph, add a paragraph.
    - Generation 14 is no lane's either.
    - [[R4159000]]'s retirement of the learned evaluation moved the AI on 2026-11-19 without moving the number, so the sweep of record, the ladder bots' re-settling and the records' builds read 13 for another AI.
    - It is recorded by hand in lane `hand` (`training/history/hand.jsonl`), its parent the last commit that held the evaluation.
    - It has no `vsRandom` and no `vsParent`, and its `shadowBan` and `parentShadowBan` are 0 (R4921000).
13. **`crates/ai/README.md`.** At the end of the "When it is swept" paragraph add: "A change to the AI that no lane promoted moves the generation by hand, in lane `hand`, with its own ruling and no gate numbers (generation 14, R4921000; `training/README.md`, Reading the history)."
14. **Measure the sweep.** Run `cargo jackioh sweep --due origin/main > /tmp/due.json`, then `jq -c '{base,baseGeneration,generation,newSets,count:(.ids|length)}' /tmp/due.json`. If `jq` is missing, use `python3 -c` to print the same fields.
    - Expect `baseGeneration` 13, `generation` 14, `newSets` `[]`.
    - Expect about 189 ids: 10 Meditative, 9 Meditative+, 85 Stinkyscape, 67 Stinkyscape+ and 18 Training Grounds. Report the measured number.
    - Write that number into the ruling note (Step 9) and into the final report.

## Tests

**New: `r4921000_the_ai_without_its_learned_evaluation_is_generation_14_and_hand_jsonl_holds_its_line`** in `crates/ai/tests/ai/dev_run.rs`:
- Parse `GENERATION_JSON`. Assert `jackioh_ai::ai_generation() == Some(14)`, with the message "generation 14 is #4921's; a later generation moves this test with its own ruling".
- Take the last non-blank line of `HAND_HISTORY`, with `.lines().rev().find(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())`, and parse it.
- For each key in `generation`, `lane`, `parent`, `tree`, `vsRandom`, `vsParent`, `parentShadowBan` and `date`, assert the history line's value equals `generation.json`'s.
- Assert `lane` is `"hand"`, `vsRandom` and `vsParent` are null, and the history line's `shadowBan` is 0.
- Skip `shadowBan` in the equality loop, and say why in a comment: `sweep.yml` rewrites it in `generation.json` alone.

**Existing tests that must still pass:**
- `r732000_…` in `shadow_ban.rs` (`shadowBan` equals `SHADOW_BAN.len()`).
- `r1367000_…` in `dev_run.rs`.
- `r4552000_calibrate_names_the_generation_and_warns_on_another` and the other `win_probability` tests.
- `agent::tests::info_reports_the_compiled_generation_and_the_sorted_shadow_ban`.
- `r1678000_…` in `sweep.rs`.
- The analysis tests: `test_load_generations_reads_this_repository_and_finds_the_generation_main_holds`, the other `load_generations` tests, and `test_notebooks.py`.

**Commands:**
```
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r4921000
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai dev_run::
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai shadow_ban::
cargo test -p jackioh-tools win_probability
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --lib info_reports
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --lib r1678000
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance ci_scope
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/ci-scope.test.ts
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo jackioh catalog check && cargo jackioh patches check
cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims
uv run --project analysis pytest analysis/tests/test_card_stats.py analysis/tests/test_notebooks.py
git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire
```
- Run the `uv` line only if `uv` exists. Otherwise report that it did not run. The analysis tests read `generation.json` and `hand.jsonl` only through `load_generations`.
- `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` must print nothing.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` is expected to report no problems; report its output.

## Done when

- [ ] `generation.json` and the `hand.jsonl` line match the format and values in Steps 2 and 5. `tree` equals `git rev-parse HEAD:crates/ai/src`.
- [ ] `r4921000_…` failed before Step 5 (output kept) and passes after.
- [ ] `WIN_PROBABILITY_AI_GENERATION` is 14, the four weights are untouched, and `cargo test -p jackioh-tools win_probability` passes.
- [ ] `shadow_ban::` and `dev_run::` pass; the analysis tests pass or the report says they did not run.
- [ ] `scripts/ci-scope.sh` has its arm, and the `ci_scope` acceptance test and `ci-scope.test.ts` pass.
- [ ] `sweep --due origin/main` shows base generation 13, generation 14, and the due count, which is in the ruling note and the report.
- [ ] `spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, `catalog check` and `patches check` pass. No `crates/ai/src` file is changed.
- [ ] The report names every command run and its result.

## Risks

- **`generation.json` layout.** The sweep's `sed` only matches `  "shadowBan": <n>,` on its own line. A reformat would make the sweep write nothing back.
- **Strict line equality would break the next sweep PR.** That PR changes `generation.json`'s `shadowBan` and not the history line. Hence `shadowBan` is read apart in the test.
- **Stale `tree`.** Any edit under `crates/ai/src/` makes `tree` wrong. This plan edits none.
- **The test is pinned to 14.** The next generation edits it, with its own ruling. The failure message says so.
- **After the merge, on `main`.**
  - `sweep.yml` starts, because the generation moved. It plays about 190 cards on both faces over up to 10 shards, and may ban cards within each set's ceiling.
  - Each ladder bot widens once on its first rated game, while `LADDER_BOTS` is on.
  - New records name 14.
  - No state is replayed or migrated, and no game hash changes.
  - The sweep's PR needs a valid `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` (`docs/repository-secrets.md`); a person checks that.
- **`bot-calibrate`** reports "no promotion since generation 13" and moves its anchor by nothing. A new calibration stays the follow-on in `docs/bot-calibration.md`.
- **`classify`** marks the change `kind:ai` (a path rule), which needs no patch fragment.

**Decisions the issue did not settle:**
1. The history comparison skips `shadowBan` (rejected: whole-line equality, which fails the first sweep PR that bans a card).
2. The test pins exactly 14 (rejected: `>= 14`, because the last-line check is tied to this generation anyway).
3. The `ci-scope.sh` arm is added, because the structural acceptance test demands it.
4. `GATE_LANES` in `arena.rs` is unchanged, because `hand` played no gate seeds.
5. R4921000 is the lowest free number in issue #4921's block.

## Open questions

None block the build. The judge's concern, 35 AI commits since 2026-11-19 without a bump, is answered by the maintainer's `Approve`. The one human item is after the merge: confirm `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` is valid before the sweep's push, or its run ends red.
````

## Risks

- **`generation.json` layout.** The sweep's `sed` only matches `  "shadowBan": <n>,` on its own line. A reformat would make the sweep write nothing back.
- **Strict line equality would break the next sweep PR.** That PR changes `generation.json`'s `shadowBan` and not the history line. Hence `shadowBan` is read apart in the test.
- **Stale `tree`.** Any edit under `crates/ai/src/` makes `tree` wrong. This plan edits none.
- **The test is pinned to 14.** The next generation edits it, with its own ruling. The failure message says so.
- **After the merge, on `main`.**
  - `sweep.yml` starts, because the generation moved. It plays about 190 cards on both faces over up to 10 shards, and may ban cards within each set's ceiling.
  - Each ladder bot widens once on its first rated game, while `LADDER_BOTS` is on.
  - New records name 14.
  - No state is replayed or migrated, and no game hash changes.
  - The sweep's PR needs a valid `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` (`docs/repository-secrets.md`); a person checks that.
- **`bot-calibrate`** reports "no promotion since generation 13" and moves its anchor by nothing. A new calibration stays the follow-on in `docs/bot-calibration.md`.
- **`classify`** marks the change `kind:ai` (a path rule), which needs no patch fragment.

**Decisions the issue did not settle:**
1. The history comparison skips `shadowBan` (rejected: whole-line equality, which fails the first sweep PR that bans a card).
2. The test pins exactly 14 (rejected: `>= 14`, because the last-line check is tied to this generation anyway).
3. The `ci-scope.sh` arm is added, because the structural acceptance test demands it.
4. `GATE_LANES` in `arena.rs` is unchanged, because `hand` played no gate seeds.
5. R4921000 is the lowest free number in issue #4921's block.

- [ ] `scripts/ci-scope.sh` has its arm, and the `ci_scope` acceptance test and `ci-scope.test.ts` pass.
- [ ] `sweep --due origin/main` shows base generation 13, generation 14, and the due count, which is in the ruling note and the report.
- [ ] `spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, `catalog check` and `patches check` pass. No `crates/ai/src` file is changed.
- [ ] The report names every command run and its result.

## Risks

- **`generation.json` layout.** The sweep's `sed` only matches `  "shadowBan": <n>,` on its own line. A reformat would make the sweep write nothing back.
- **Strict line equality would break the next sweep PR.** That PR changes `generation.json`'s `shadowBan` and not the history line. Hence `shadowBan` is read apart in the test.
- **Stale `tree`.** Any edit under `crates/ai/src/` makes `tree` wrong. This plan edits none.
- **The test is pinned to 14.** The next generation edits it, with its own ruling. The failure message says so.
- **After the merge, on `main`.**
  - `sweep.yml` starts, because the generation moved. It plays about 190 cards on both faces over up to 10 shards, and may ban cards within each set's ceiling.
  - Each ladder bot widens once on its first rated game, while `LADDER_BOTS` is on.
  - New records name 14.
  - No state is replayed or migrated, and no game hash changes.
  - The sweep's PR needs a valid `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` (`docs/repository-secrets.md`); a person checks that.
- **`bot-calibrate`** reports "no promotion since generation 13" and moves its anchor by nothing. A new calibration stays the follow-on in `docs/bot-calibration.md`.
- **`classify`** marks the change `kind:ai` (a path rule), which needs no patch fragment.

**Decisions the issue did not settle:**
1. The history comparison skips `shadowBan` (rejected: whole-line equality, which fails the first sweep PR that bans a card).
2. The test pins exactly 14 (rejected: `>= 14`, because the last-line check is tied to this generation anyway).
3. The `ci-scope.sh` arm is added, because the structural acceptance test demands it.
4. `GATE_LANES` in `arena.rs` is unchanged, because `hand` played no gate seeds.
5. R4921000 is the lowest free number in issue #4921's block.

## Open questions

None block the build. The judge's concern, 35 AI commits since 2026-11-19 without a bump, is answered by the maintainer's `Approve`. The one human item is after the merge: confirm `LEARN_LANE_TOKEN` is valid before the sweep's push, or its run ends red.
